title: The 1962 Benny Carter, Ben Webster and Barney Bigard record
summary: The BBB date in April 1962 was Leonard Feather's, and Bigard recorded it sick with a 104 fever.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Has he got the record "BBB"? Benny Carter, Ben Webster, and Barney Bigard?
When -- What year would that be? I don't remember seeing it when I looked here before.
Yeah, and I was sick, too.
That was Leonard Feather's date. And
I was sick, too. I was sick as a dog that day.
Um. That must be a great record.
You and Ben Webster and Benny.
